config.hypothesis: Incomplete reconstruction, learner state support and action consequences are distinct possible obstacles to transferring successful Walker teacher behavior; diagnose them without changing learning or search.
config.stopping: Run D1 once, then all20unmodified replay branches before any substituted branch. Stop on any provenance, snapshot, numerical replay, memory, wall, storage or work-budget failure; retain partial evidence. No replacement sources, relaxed tolerances, extra anchors, retries, inference, fitting, MPPI queries or follow-up intervention.
config.claim_scope: Descriptive saved-state support and single-action causal effects under a fixed open-loop teacher continuation. Neither diagnoses a unique cause, measures recovery/teachability, nor establishes policy competence or earlier-time importance. Two teacher source trajectories are not20independent task replications.
config.next_stage: Close with established/supported/unresolved findings and one separately versioned unlaunched learning protocol for review.
